user_goal: I want a local-first media production and review workbench for individual creators or small teams. It can import video, audio, and asset files, organize a material library, define a processing workflow, generate clip or item analysis, flag candidate content worth reviewing, choose outputs, export a project package, and generate a processing report. It cannot depend on cloud services and must not pretend to have real AI models. CGKN should decide the real requirement, MVP scope, non-goals, acceptance criteria, and generate a runnable local project.
